name: slop-guard
description: Expose Slop-Guard prose analysis tools and a trusted response check.

args: die() { printf '%s\n' "slop-guard plugin: $1" >&2; exit 1; }; canonicalize_file() { target=$1; links=0; while [ -L "$target" ]; do links=$((links + 1)); [ "$links" -le 40 ] || return 1; link=$(command -p readlink "$target" 2>/dev/null) || return 1; case "$link" in /*) target=$link ;; *) target=${target%/*}/$link ;; esac; done; parent=${target%/*}; name=${target##*/}; [ "$parent" != "$target" ] || parent=.; canonical_parent=$(CDPATH= cd -P "$parent" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1; printf '%s/%s\n' "$canonical_parent" "$name"; }; canonicalize_directory() { CDPATH= cd -P "$1" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P; }; is_in_git_worktree() { directory=${1%/*}; while :; do if [ -e "$directory/.git" ] || [ -L "$directory/.git" ]; then return 0; fi; [ "$directory" != / ] || return 1; directory=${directory%/*}; [ -n "$directory" ] || directory=/; done; }; trust_target() { target=$1; if is_in_git_worktree "$target"; then die 'refusing executable from a Git worktree'; fi; if [ -n "${VIRTUAL_ENV-}" ]; then environment_root=$(canonicalize_directory "$VIRTUAL_ENV") || die 'cannot verify active virtual environment'; [ "$environment_root" != / ] || die 'refusing executable from active virtual environment'; case "$target" in "$environment_root"|"$environment_root"/*) die 'refusing executable from active virtual environment' ;; esac; fi; }; search_path=${PATH-}; remaining=$search_path; slop_guard_bin=''; while :; do case "$remaining" in *:*) entry=${remaining%%:*}; remaining=${remaining#*:}; more=true ;; *) entry=$remaining; more=false ;; esac; case "$entry" in /*) candidate=$entry/slop-guard; if [ -f "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate" ]; then slop_guard_bin=$(canonicalize_file "$candidate") || die 'cannot canonicalize installed slop-guard'; trust_target "$slop_guard_bin"; break; fi ;; *) [ -n "$entry" ] || entry=.; candidate=$entry/slop-guard; if [ -f "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate" ]; then die 'refusing slop-guard from an empty or relative PATH entry'; fi ;; esac; [ "$more" = true ] || break; done; [ -n "$slop_guard_bin" ] || die 'installed slop-guard not found on absolute PATH entries'; [ -f "$slop_guard_bin" ] && [ -x "$slop_guard_bin" ] || die 'installed slop-guard is not executable'; unset PYTHONHOME PYTHONPATH; exec "$slop_guard_bin"

interface.shortDescription: Rule-based prose checks for agent responses
interface.longDescription: Use Slop-Guard MCP tools to analyze prose and optionally report formulaic writing patterns when the main agent stops.
